Name: Michaela Ladak
Description: Michaela Ladak was a young popular girl whom eventually found out she was a mutant. However, her powers where not 'sexy' or 'useful'; her saliva was so strong she could use it for a number of things, including styling her hair. Michaela Ladak was created by Sina Grace and Alessandor Vitti and first appeared in Iceman Vol.3 issue 1 (2017).
